# EnhancedPets 1.3.1

This is a follow-up release for three reported pet-management issues.

## Fixes

- **Baby Happy Ghasts can be fed snowballs again**
  - Snowball interactions on baby Happy Ghasts are no longer intercepted as taming attempts.
  - Applies to managed pets as well, so “already registered” no longer blocks vanilla growth.

- **Freed pets no longer come back**
  - Freed pets now get a persistent “freed” marker when their entity is not loaded.
  - When the chunk loads, the marker untames and releases the entity instead of re-registering it as a managed pet.
  - Freed pets are also made persistent so they do not immediately despawn.
  - This fixes the “free it twice” behaviour and pets reappearing after a server restart.

- **Newly tamed pets register reliably**
  - Registration no longer relies solely on `EntityTameEvent`.
  - Taming interactions and horse mounting now schedule an immediate registration check.
  - A background safety scan registers any nearby tamed pets that were missed.
  - This covers cats, wolves, and horses on newer server versions such as 1.21.9.

## Upgrade notes

- Replace `enhancedpets-1.3.0.jar` with `enhancedpets-1.3.1.jar`.
- Existing config and player data are compatible; no manual migration is needed.
